page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.3xlarge is a dedicated compute-oriented virtual server belonging to the High Clock Speed instance family. Built on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture, this instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at a sustained clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The configuration provides 12 dedicated vCPUs alongside 48.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance operates without integrated hardware accelerators or bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for non-volatile persistence.

Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 10 Gbps, ensuring stable network transfer rates across enterprise environments. Public IPv4 addresses are not bundled with the instance by default and must be provisioned independently. While synthetic and application-level benchmark telemetry is currently unrecorded for this specific instance tier, the high base frequency of 3.3 GHz targets workloads sensitive to per-thread execution speed.

Cost efficiency for the ecs.hfg8i.3xlarge is driven by its high single-core processor frequency combined with a general-purpose memory density, avoiding the overhead of specialized acceleration hardware. Tradeoffs center on the absence of ephemeral NVMe storage, meaning disk I/O performance relies fully on external block storage services. This instance is best suited for application servers, batch processing pipelines, enterprise resource planning (ERP) deployments, relational databases, and compute workloads requiring sustained high per-core execution speeds.
